class.name: IvyMeshSettings
class.brief_description: Serializable configuration resource for 3D stem meshing and leaf placement.
class.description: [IvyMeshSettings] exposes stem tube tessellation and deterministic leaf placement parameters for [IvyMeshBuilder] to the Godot Inspector and GDScript, and supports saving and loading as [code].tres[/code] or [code].res[/code] preset resources.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], closes the terminal end of each stem chain with a tapered apex cap.
Average number of leaves placed per world unit of stem length ([code]>= 0[/code]). A value of [code]0.0[/code] disables leaf placement.
Maximum interpolated stem thickness eligible for leaf placement ([code]>= 0[/code]; useful for keeping thick woody trunks bare). A value of [code]0.0[/code] imposes no upper thickness limit.
Minimum interpolated stem thickness required for leaf placement ([code]>= 0[/code]; useful for keeping dried withered twigs leafless).
Maximum random roll jitter in degrees around each leaf's blade axis ([code]-Z[/code]; [code]>= 0[/code]).
Deterministic PCG32 seed controlling leaf spacing jitter, side alternation, orientation jitter, and scale variation.
Maximum uniform leaf scale multiplier ([code]>= leaf_size_min[/code]).
Angle in degrees lifting each leaf blade outward from the wall plane toward [code]wall_normal[/code], within [code][0, 90][/code].
Maximum random yaw jitter in degrees around the local stem surface ([code]>= 0[/code]).
Number of radial sides around each cylindrical stem ring ([code]>= 3[/code]).
Multiplier converting graph point thickness into cylinder radius ([code]> 0[/code]; [code]0.5[/code] treats graph thickness as diameter).
Multiplier scaling accumulated world arc length into texture V coordinates along each stem ([code]> 0[/code]).
Fraction of tube radius by which ring centers are offset along [code]wall_normal[/code] so stems adhere to the surface without floating ([code]>= 0[/code]).
